ops.statement: run_crew.py spawns crews via a headless 'claude --role --handoff' CLI binary (launch_process/subprocess.run); in environments where crews are Agent-tool subagents there is no such binary. Closest-compliant path: dispatch the implementer/reviewer via the Agent tool, and record each attempt in crew-runs.json using run_crew.py's pure registry functions (session_name/next_attempt/active_duplicate/result_exists) so duplicate-guard + result-artifact verification are preserved; run recover_crews before each dispatch.
ops.grounding: issue-446 AGENT_FEEDBACK 2026-06-11 entry (Instruction adherence: material workflow misfit); all 7 crew dispatches used the Agent tool with registry recorded via run_crew pure functions.

ops.statement: DatabaseManager is NOT a read-only path: its __init__ runs a schema-ensure write. For truly read-only access to the canonical season DBs (e.g. physics/preprocessing telemetry-truth reads), open a direct sqlite connection with a 'file:<path>?mode=ro' URI instead of instantiating DatabaseManager.
ops.grounding: issue-446 g2 implementer + reviewer: db_truth_loader.py bypassed DatabaseManager and used file:?mode=ro to avoid a canonical-DB write; reviewer confirmed no write path.

ops.statement: FastF1 pos_data X/Y are in DECIMETRES, not metres — multiply by 0.1 for arc-length/distance in metres. Verified by ratio ~10 vs FastF1's own Distance column (6941.6m computed vs 6949.5m FastF1 on a Spa lap).
ops.grounding: issue-446 g2 review: independent throwaway script measured raw arc 69415.7 units, *0.1 = 6941.6m vs FastF1 Distance 6949.5m, ratio 9.99.

ops.statement: The spine engine lease goes stale after lease_stale_seconds (default 1800s) of no heartbeat; a >30min crew step will lapse it and the next mutating verb is refused until you re-claim (same id, or --force --reason). Re-claim with --force on resume rather than treating it as an error.
ops.grounding: issue-446 run: after the g3 multi-session crew run, 'advance execute' was REFUSED ('lease cmdr-446 is stale'); re-claimed with --force --reason and continued.
